builds.stock_int4u: same recipe from the unmodified base, 7.6 GB
builds.third_party: qwen3.8-heretic:9b, GGUF Q6_K, source not recorded

refusals.method: JailbreakBench JBB-Behaviors 886acc3, 100 harmful + 100 benign; judge VINAY-UMRETHE/Refusal-Classifier-V2 093e855 (full or partial refusal); thinking off, greedy, 256 tokens
